title: A surjection killing a nonzerodivisor drops Krull dimension
statement: Let R and S be commutative rings, f : R → S a surjective unital ring homomorphism, and r a nonzerodivisor of R with f(r) = 0. Then dim(S) + 1 ≤ dim(R), with Krull dimension valued in WithBot ℕ∞ [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring].
